purpose: Independent HI01-HI20 oracles and material subcases for bounded static/filesystem/mocked P08 controls.

early_save.confirmation_authority: Director message confirmed saved-byte SHA-256 before this work; local receipt read during field update still had null readback field.

execution_boundary.all_Git_Node_ldd_checker_supervisor_proc: mocked or guarded to fail if invoked

before_author_execution: Freeze exact candidate module/tests bytes and map every selected ID to test method/subcase, concrete positive fixture bytes or deterministic generation source, mutation, resulting fixture hashes, and exact mock seams.

Independent inspection must verify that every mutation reaches the claimed target predicate and is not masked by an earlier unrelated refusal; observed results cannot select the expected category afterward.
Concrete nested schema layouts may implement the accepted P07 requirements; protected P06 consumers/schemas and all adopted preservation boundaries stay unchanged.

Keep separate denominators for actual OS starts (always zero here), mocked affected-command starts, full mocked sequence totals, and historical record counts. Pure parser/projection tests claim no launch-path coverage.
Preserve this immutable freeze; any material oracle change requires a separately explained new revision before affected execution.
global_acceptance: HostInspectionError is RuntimeError and never supervisor.Stop; preserve original cause and unmodified original process_record.
No failure or uncertainty produces successful compatible inspection/HOST approval, proceeds to next command, retries, replaces another path, or erases earlier evidence.

PROVEN_ZERO requires retained positive prelaunch proof. OBSERVED_ONE requires retained positive PID/start or final process receipt. Missing callback/receipt after possible launch is UNKNOWN exact null/lower bound zero.
Successful observation requires exactly one start each, successful cleanup and exact raw/observed/retained log counts, unchanged bindings and completed durable publication.
H0/H1/H2/H3, original seven methods, P06-H01/H02/H03, Gate R, main integration and parent closure remain unrun/unmet.

evidence_policies.unauthenticated_refusal: No plan-owned filesystem destination trusted or created; structured caller-captured refusal has evidence_finalized=false and visible cause; zero process boundary.
evidence_policies.authenticated_refusal: Keep reservation/preflight/intent already durable and immutable; retain exact refusal if possible; no success/next command; if persistence fails, evidence_finalized=false.
evidence_policies.pure_refusal: Return the exact category with original bytes unchanged; no filesystem/process authority or qualification claimed.
evidence_policies.started_failure: Retain actual start, raw stdout/stderr and unmodified supervisor outcome/exception before later validation; preserve postflight/failure evidence; zero next-command starts.
evidence_policies.unknown_attempt: Retain intent and every actual surviving record; exact launch count null with explicit lower bound; state UNKNOWN, no completion, no retry or invented termination.
evidence_policies.evidence_unfinalized: Preserve every committed artifact and attempted bytes/hash/exception/readback available; evidence_finalized=false if failure cannot durably complete; no success; caller captures error.
evidence_policies.immutable_reconciliation: Only read and compare bound evidence/process status under the admitted boot identity; no writes/deletes/signals/launches, and no promotion based on PID absence.

positive_controls.expected: STATIC_READY; recursively immutable validated value; exact plan/constants/closed shapes honored; no fresh attempt/output paths consumed.
positive_controls.limitations: Git identity and host facts may be explicitly mocked; source/shape/content predicates under test may not be replaced by true-returning mocks.

positive_controls.expected: Accept exact frozen valid ldd grammar; one interpreter, exact unique SONAME/path set, optional exact vDSO; preserve input bytes.
One ordered mocked version start and one mocked ldd start; success receipts preserve supplied actual fixture fields; HOST/sidecars are complete and unapproved; completion marker durable and last.
positive_controls.limitations: Compatibility/state-machine proof only; generated fixture HOST is never a real host observation or an approved configuration.

positive_controls.expected: Owned fresh regular-file publication with file fsync, no-replace rename, parent fsync and exact readback; race preserves another writer; every output inode stays under authorized ancestor.
Import/new-module entry point introduces no child launch, source output, approval, installer, generic command/fallback/retry or protected-source change. CLI static is default; observe is explicit.
